describe.description: The creature is a single chimeric quadruped shown in right-facing profile walking forward. It has the overall size, proportions, dense shaggy brown fur, and limbs of a brown bear, but its back is covered from the nape to the rump by a large, highly glossy, hard, reddish-brown beetle carapace, and a single large, curved, glossy dark horn rises from its forehead. The fur is light tan on the muzzle and face, medium brown on the body, and darker brown on the lower legs, with a thick ruff around the neck and shoulders. The beetle shell is domed and smooth with fine longitudinal ridges and appears fused to the dorsal midline, giving the animal a bear-beetle hybrid appearance.
